# What is CoLab?  AI for engineering collaboration?

**Yes, here’s what that means:** CoLab brings together product development teams to do better, faster design iterations. Any time you need to make a design decision, open CoLab. You’ll be able to visualize and compare designs, discuss them with other people, track comments, and get AI-powered suggestions based on your organization’s collective technical knowledge.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/6911a50fe16414e497f8026a_5353.avif)![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/690dbbd94a89d3fbc6b2184f_75.svg)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/6911c4fe6a29fa6b5b6059e7_678763.svg)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/6911c5ac46d82527625c5f2d_Frame%201171274479.svg)

It’s a new kind of software [that integrates](https://www.colabsoftware.com/product/integrations) with all of those tools, so technical teams can improve designs faster – with all the right data at their fingertips. We call it an EngineeringOS.

## What can I do with CoLab?

### Share and view design files

- Share designs from PLM, without exporting to STEP or creating a pack-and-go
- Generate unique links that open CAD in a lightweight, browser based viewer
- Interrogate models, with built-in tools to section, take measurements, and more

[LEARN MORE](https://www.colabsoftware.com/product/model-interrogation-analysis)

![Comment example](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/69113fe1083aef8d16a47a48_690b4f10c40b19c9aa62ef01_6634cbfa6a9f9107eeb34dbe_TC%20Integration%20Module%201%201.avif)

![Comment example](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/69114006312fffc41ac6dc27_6904a3e8cf3ecd407161c412_Image%20Template%20(3).avif)

### Create and discuss annotations

- Pin design comments to model geometry and create saved view states
- Support comments with markups, including arrows, text boxes, GD&T symbols, and feature control frames
- Built in discussion threads with @mentions to send notifications to new reviewers

[LEARN MORE](https://www.colabsoftware.com/product/create-design-feedback)

### Track, organize, and close issues

- As you create feedback on models or drawings, CoLab automatically organizes that feedback into a tracking database
- Every feedback item can be assigned an owner and status
- Create custom tags and issue types to filter, sort, or prioritize issues

[LEARN MORE](https://www.colabsoftware.com/product/track-and-resolve-issues)

![Activity overview](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/6904a5bdefbc7338fd05a3a2_Image%20Template%20(5).png)

![Activity overview](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/691140b2e01153676e1b27f1_6910e6039e2a349a1f4ad743_Frame%201171274369.avif)

### Turn institutional knowledge into an AI-ready data model

- Machine learning algorithms spot similarities between designs across global programs
- Historical reviews on similar designs forms the basis for automatic lessons learned
- CoLab’s ingestion engine reads standards, guidelines, NCRs, and other data – regardless of format – to further refine AI output. It can even cite your documentation.

[LEARN MORE](https://www.colabsoftware.com/product/ai-knowledge-graph)

### Speed up iterations with AI agents

- AutoReview is an AI peer checker that annotates drawings and models with design feedback based on your standards and guidelines
- CoLab’s Lessons Learned Agent finds similar designs and surfaces insights from past reviews on those designs, automating the traditional lessons learned process
- These are the first of many out-of-the-box AI agents – each one able to reference your organization’s collective design knowledge

[LEARN MORE](https://www.colabsoftware.com/product/autoreview)

![Activity overview](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e4d9854e6dad067f4b514b3/6911410ee219bb4e9f23bb5f_683db8a45cb65e2bafa6a3f9_Background.avif)

## Connecting CoLab with PLM and CAD is fast, easy, and secure.

CoLab integrates with major PLM systems, including Windchill, Teamcenter, and 3DXPERIENCE. You can share CAD directly to CoLab from your PLM, maintaining critical data associations. Because CoLab accepts 30+ file types, it’s easy to review native CAD, even if you’re working with a supplier or customer that uses a different CAD tool.

[LEARN MORE ABOUT INTEGRATIONS](https://www.colabsoftware.com/product/integrations)

## Frequently Asked Questions

[**What kinds of engineering decisions does CoLab AI help influence?**](https://www.colabsoftware.com/product/overview#)

CoLab helps engineers make better design decisions by surfacing everything the organization already knows—design rules, DFM best practices, lessons from past programs, and standards such as ASME. It brings that context directly into live design reviews, guiding decisions around dimensioning, tolerances, notes, hole placement, and manufacturability so teams don’t have to reinvent the wheel.

[**How does CoLab codify and surface design knowledge?**](https://www.colabsoftware.com/product/overview#)

CoLab automatically captures and organizes design comments alongside 3D geometry and the revision they refer to. Every piece of feedback becomes part of a searchable “master issue database” that consolidates insights across programs. This transforms scattered tribal knowledge—often trapped in decks or email threads—into structured, AI-ready data that can be reused in future reviews.

[**How does CoLab know what’s relevant during a review?**](https://www.colabsoftware.com/product/overview#)

CoLab’s Similarity Engine converts CAD and drawings into AI-readable formats and compares them across your entire product history to find similar parts. It then identifies historical feedback patterns and design changes from those similar components. During a live review, AI surfaces the insights and recommendations most likely to help your team make a better decision right then and there.

[**How does CoLab ensure the knowledge it captures stays accurate?**](https://www.colabsoftware.com/product/overview#)

Continuous use of CoLab creates both cultural and technical reinforcement loops. Engineers are more motivated to keep standards up to date because they see those standards actively improving daily work. On the technical side, CoLab’s ingestion engine centralizes all design rules and lessons learned—no data cleanup required—and the AI cites the original documentation whenever it generates feedback. Engineers can inspect the citation directly beside the design, and thumbs-up/down feedback helps refine accuracy over time. If outdated guidance exists, regular use of the system helps expose and correct it faster than traditional methods.

[**How does CoLab fit with my existing CAD and PLM systems?**](https://www.colabsoftware.com/product/overview#)

CoLab works with more than 30 native and neutral CAD file types, converting them into lightweight, web-viewable 3D models for fast, collaborative reviews—no “pack and go” needed. It integrates with leading PLMs such as Windchill, Teamcenter, 3DEXPERIENCE, and SOLIDWORKS PDM to sync metadata, detect revisions automatically, and ensure teams are always working on the right version. This eliminates risky exports and keeps permissions aligned with your enterprise systems.

[**How does CoLab protect data and IP?**](https://www.colabsoftware.com/product/overview#)

CoLab’s cloud security program is independently audited to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 standards. Permissioning can mirror your existing enterprise configurations, ensuring users only see what they’re authorized to see. The same rigor applies to AI security—data protection and model isolation are designed to meet the expectations of IT, compliance, and OEM security teams. CoLab’s security specialists are available to brief customer IT teams in detail.
